zh-Hans: 只要冲上直道，就算弯里被咬住，我也能轻松甩开！
en: Once I hit the straight, I can pull away again, even if he catches me in the corners!

zh-Hans: 我现在可是热血沸腾啊！
en: I'm really fired up now!

zh-Hans: 后面的路还长，按自己的节奏跑就行！
en: There's a long way to go. Just keep my own pace!

zh-Hans: 真过瘾，好久没这么全力跑过了！
en: What a rush! It's been ages since I went all out like this!

zh-Hans: 他怎么还能这么镇定？
en: How can he stay so calm?

zh-Hans: 怎么可能，我的跑法竟然不管用？！
en: Impossible! Is my driving not good enough?!

zh-Hans: 哼！
en: Hmph!

zh-Hans: 他就这么有把握？这股莫名的压迫感，到底是怎么回事？
en: He's that confident? Where's this unnerving pressure coming from?

zh-Hans: 不妙啊，没想到他快到这种地步。
en: I've got a bad feeling. I didn't think he was this fast.

zh-Hans: 别急，冷静下来等机会就好。
en: Don't panic. Stay calm and wait for a chance.

zh-Hans: 好快，比想象中还快！
en: Fast. Faster than I imagined!

zh-Hans: 竟能跟我的四百马力较劲？！
en: He can take on my four hundred horsepower?!

zh-Hans: 这算怎么回事？！
en: What the hell was that?!

zh-Hans: 超乎想象！
en: Unbelievable!

zh-Hans: 可恶！
en: Gah!

zh-Hans: 呜！
en: Ugh!

zh-Hans: 糟了！
en: Damn it!

zh-Hans: 怎、怎么可能！
en: No... Impossible!

zh-Hans: 对手的水平，比我预想的高得多啊。
en: He's on a much higher level than I expected.

zh-Hans: 厉害，真是厉害得让人没话说。
en: Amazing. I don't even know what else to say.

zh-Hans: 这就是所谓的毫无还手之力吧。
en: So this is what it feels like to be completely outclassed.

zh-Hans: 我以为直道加速是我的车更强，难道只是错觉？
en: I thought my car accelerated better on the straights. Was I imagining it?

zh-Hans: 争取最快圈速，赛道和山路的跑法应该是一样的。
en: Going for a fast time should work the same on a circuit or a mountain pass.

zh-Hans: 车身是不轻，可它这颗心脏照样能拉着车直往上冲！
en: It's no lightweight, but it's got an engine that hauls it uphill with ease!

zh-Hans: 有本事就超啊，帅小子！
en: Pass me if you can, pretty boy!

zh-Hans: 出弯的动力是我占优！
en: I've got more power out of the corners!

zh-Hans: 直道上还是我更有后劲！
en: I've got the edge on the straights!

zh-Hans: 他不可能在弯里发动攻势！
en: He can't make a move in the corners!

zh-Hans: 好，能行！肯定能守到最后！
en: Yes, I can do it! I can keep him behind me!

zh-Hans: 就这样甩开他，赢的就是我！
en: If I stay out in front, this win is mine!

zh-Hans: 我在赛道上跑的那些圈可不是白跑的！
en: All those laps on the circuit weren't for nothing!

zh-Hans: 好，跟预想的一样！
en: Good. Just as I pictured it!

zh-Hans: 比我想的快，不过也到此为止了！
en: You're quicker than I thought, but this is as far as you go!

zh-Hans: 这种时候还不拼，那要等到什么时候？！
en: If I don't push my luck now, when will I?!

zh-Hans: 丢了自己的节奏才致命。我就按自己的跑法来，不用花哨的动作，也不用漂移！
en: Losing my own rhythm would be fatal. I'll drive my way. No flashy moves, no drifting!

zh-Hans: 丢了自己的节奏才致命。我就按自己的跑法来！
en: Losing my own rhythm would be fatal. I'll drive my way!

zh-Hans: 空当太大了！
en: Wide open!

zh-Hans: 在这里超过去，就跟赢了没两样！
en: If I pass him here, it's as good as won!

zh-Hans: 别怪我啊！
en: No hard feelings!

zh-Hans: 好，很好！
en: Yes, that's it!

zh-Hans: 感觉不错！
en: Looking good!

zh-Hans: 哎！
en: Hey!

zh-Hans: 照这样跑下去，我赢定了！
en: Keep this up, and the win is mine!

zh-Hans: 就把这条山路当赛道，拿出刷圈速时的跑法！
en: I'll attack this pass just like I'm going for a lap record on the circuit!

zh-Hans: 让你见识四百马力全开的上坡赛！
en: I'll show you a full-throttle, four-hundred-horsepower hill climb!

zh-Hans: 不知道你有多大本事，但我没那么容易输。让你看看 SEVEN STAR 的骨气！
en: I don't know how good you are, but I won't go down easily. I'll show you Seven Star Leaf's pride!
